dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular, jagged closed-loop and 'C' shaped perimeters on the anterior dorsal-lateral flank displaying sharp gradient transitions from a dark charcoal exterior to an off-white interior outline.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low-density distribution of small, solid off-white pixel clusters scattered ventrally and towards the posterior mid-section, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A non-linear configuration of approximately five interconnected irregular polygons defined by the centroids of the prominent macro-annuli located on the upper anterior flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized, brownish-tinted circular patch of contrasting texture and color located on the lateral surface of the hind flipper.
